ModMetaData.name: Fewer Freezes – Smart Memory Cleanup
ModMetaData.author: Bolek98
ModMetaData.description:
Fewer hitches and freezes in big modded colonies.
RimWorld cleans its memory from time to time and the game stops while it does. The more memory a heavily modded game holds, the longer it stops – up to several seconds. This mod controls when and how that clean-up happens.
- Smart ongoing clean-up: the game may tidy memory a little every frame, more when it holds a lot (3–12 ms instead of a fixed 3 ms), so big stops come less often. - Big clean-up while paused and right after saving – when the game stops anyway, not in the middle of play. - Freeze meter: see how many freezes you had in the last hour and how many came from memory clean-up. - Warning when the computer is running out of memory, with tips what to do. - Optional: free unused textures and sounds during a longer pause. - Optional small display with memory, the last stop and a memory graph. - "Clean up memory now" button. - Recommended settings switch – works right away.
It cannot give the game "more memory" – RimWorld already takes what it needs. Safe to add to or remove from a save. Czech and English.
(Formerly "Memory Tuner".)
